review.reason: The illustration closely follows the mapped course and style, with natural continuous greens and clearly striped fairways. The mapped walking connector from G3 to T1 is not visible.

issues.detail: The tan walking connector from G3 to T1 shown in the authoritative diagram is missing between the bottom-center green and the nearby tee.
issues.consequence: Viewers will not see the approved walking connection from G3 to T1 in the course overview.
